subject: Pudding King
fact: Pudding King is a former humanoid who transformed into a sentient, telepathic ooze after embracing his connection to Juiblex, the demon lord of oozes. He commanded an army of oozes and possessed powerful abilities including slime waves and green slime attacks. He was grappled and dragged out of his lair by Zalthir, and at one point swapped positions with Glabbagool. He was ultimately defeated and dissolved, screaming 'Behold the true feast, the soul's final blend!' as he died.
source_quote: Pudding King telepathically screams about shedding his humanoid form for supreme power and his intention to reduce all of the Underdark to ooze.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is an intelligent gelatinous cube who was previously affected by demonic power. During the battle, he somehow swapped positions with the Pudding King, causing confusion for the party. After the Pudding King's defeat, Glabbagool returned to his original form and expressed excitement about potentially being carried in a jar or Bag of Holding, viewing his new mobility as an opportunity to experience the world differently. He sees himself as a potential garbage disposal and is interested in monk training.
source_quote: Glabbagool, now in his original gelatinous cube form, expresses confusion about what happened.

subject: Prince Livid
fact: Prince Livid is an ooze ally of the Pudding King who attacked with psychic blasts. He was resistant to fire damage, which allowed him to survive Daz's initial Fireball with only eight hit points remaining. He was ultimately killed by Daz's Magic Missile.
source_quote: Prince Livid attacks Zalthir with a psychic blast, dealing fourteen points of damage reduced to seven by a successful intelligence saving throw.

subject: Princess Ebonmire
fact: Princess Ebonmire is an ooze ally of the Pudding King who attacked by throwing blobs and charging at the party. She was killed by the party's combined efforts, and after her death, a spellbook containing many spells was found in her stomach.
source_quote: Princess Ebonmire throws a blob at Thorin, but it misses.

subject: Juiblex
fact: Juiblex is the demon lord of oozes, whose power was channeled through the Pudding King. After the Pudding King's defeat, his infernal influence receded from the area, but a demonic voice claimed he would be reborn by consuming the Queen of Fungi.
source_quote: A demonic voice, possibly Juiblex himself, declares: 'You haven't won. I will be reborn. I will consume the banquet of the queen of the fungi, and I will grow.'

subject: Zuggtmoy
fact: Zuggtmoy is the Lady of Rot and Demon Lord of Fungi. After Juiblex's defeat, the fungi in the area became more twisted, suggesting she was waiting to seize power in the vacuum left by the Pudding King's death.
source_quote: The fungi in the area become more twisted, suggesting Zuggtmoy is waiting to seize power.

subject: Throne Room
fact: The throne room is the Pudding King's throne room, accessed through a hole created by an Earth Elemental. The room contains green slime hazards on the ceiling that can drop on those beneath them. It served as the Pudding King's lair, granting him special lair actions until he was dragged out of it.
source_quote: The party breaches the throne room entrance using an Earth Elemental and prepares to confront the Pudding King.

subject: Bag of Holding
fact: The Bag of Holding is a magical bag capable of storing vast amounts of items and potentially creatures. The party discussed using it to contain the Pudding King, but the DM ruled that while it could temporarily deprive an ooze of an action, a sentient ooze could 'ooze out' of it and escape. Glabbagool later expressed interest in being carried in it.
source_quote: Zalthir proposes shoving the Pudding King into a Bag of Holding.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a magical weapon wielded by Thorin that emits light in a twenty-foot radius and deals radiant damage. It was used to attack the Pudding King after the party realized he had swapped positions with Glabbagool.
source_quote: Thorin attacks the correct target (the Pudding King in Glabbagool's body) with Dawnbringer, dealing twelve points of radiant damage.

subject: Spellbook
fact: The Spellbook is a spellbook containing many spells, found in Princess Ebonmire's stomach after her death. It significantly expanded the party's magical repertoire.
source_quote: The party finds a spellbook containing many spells, which was in Princess Ebonmire's stomach.

subject: Magic Missile
fact: Magic Missile is a reliable force damage spell cast by Daz multiple times during the battle. It does not require a roll to hit and has a range of 120 feet. Daz used it at both first and third level, with the third-level version dealing twenty points of damage to the Pudding King. The final Magic Missile killed Prince Livid.
source_quote: Daz casts Magic Missile at the Pudding King, dealing six points of damage.

subject: Guiding Bolt
fact: Guiding Bolt is a spell cast by Grygum early in the battle that missed its target.
source_quote: Grygum casts Guiding Bolt at the Pudding King, but it misses.

subject: Stone Skin
fact: Stone Skin is a temporary magical effect that grants resistance to a chosen damage type for one round, usable once per long rest. Multiple party members used it to resist acid damage from the Pudding King's slime wave attacks.
source_quote: Zalthir takes eleven points of acid damage, using Stone Skin to reduce it to five.

subject: Inflict Wounds
fact: Inflict Wounds is a necrotic damage spell cast by Grygum that requires the target to make a constitution saving throw. It was used successfully against the Pudding King for twenty-three points of damage and against Princess Ebonmire for eighteen points of damage.
source_quote: Grygum casts Inflict Wounds on the Pudding King, dealing twenty-three points of damage.

subject: Fireball
fact: Fireball is a powerful area-of-effect spell cast by Daz that deals fire damage in a large area. It dealt twenty-nine points of damage to both Prince Livid and Princess Ebonmire, though Prince Livid's fire resistance reduced his damage to fourteen points.
source_quote: Daz casts Fireball, dealing twenty-nine points of damage to both Prince Livid and Princess Ebonmire.

subject: Shadow Step
fact: Shadow Step is a monk ability used by Zalthir to teleport short distances, allowing him to quickly close the gap to enemies. He used it to reach the Pudding King and Princess Ebonmire during combat.
source_quote: Zalthir uses Shadow Step to teleport near the Pudding King.

subject: Second Wind
fact: Second Wind is an ability used by Thorin to heal himself during the battle.
source_quote: Thorin uses Second Wind to heal himself.

subject: Eldritch Claw
fact: Eldritch Claw is an ability used by Zalthir that adds force damage to his melee attacks, manifesting as damage from his tentacles. Each hit adds 1d6 force damage.
source_quote: Zalthir continues attacking with punches and Eldritch Claw damage from his tentacles, dealing a total of thirty-seven points of damage.

subject: Revivify
fact: Revivify is a resurrection spell mentioned by Zalthir as a potential option to help Glabbagool, though it was not cast as Glabbagool was not dead.
source_quote: Revivify is a resurrection spell mentioned by Zalthir as a potential option to help Glabbagool, though it was not cast as Glabbagool was not dead.
